summary: Tests whether a byte flag and a word mask indicate a set condition, indexing two global lookup tables by a1. Returns 1 if the byte flag a3 has any bit in common with byte_8D47E1[a1], or if a2 is non-zero and has any bit in common with word_5E69D2[a1]. Returns 0 otherwise.

operations.description: If (a3 & byte_8D47E1[index]) is non-zero, return 1 immediately.
Compute maskedWord: when a2 is non-zero, (a2 & word_5E69D2[index]) truncated to 16 bits; otherwise 0.
Return maskedWord (0 when no bit matched in either table).

unresolved: The semantic roles of byte_8D47E1 and word_5E69D2 (e.g. per-index input/modifier bit masks) and the meaning of the index a1 are unknown.
The single static caller is 0x00596DFE (ThreeArgCallWrapper); its relationship to this predicate is not analyzed here.
Why the word test casts to a 16-bit value while the byte test does not is unexplained.
